conviction_note: The findings sum to +3.7. The scaled number, +2.4 = (2*0.58-1)*15, is smaller because the main positive is arithmetic from the company's own Q2 numbers and the transcript, not a disclosed Q3 figure, so p_up sits only at 58 against a 15% implied move. Both numbers lean the same way; the gap between them is the uncertainty about whether Embedded holds its Q2 level.
bar: Company Q3 2026 guide: revenue $26-30M (midpoint $28M, ~30% y/y), adj. EBITDA loss $6-9M; FY2026 $119-123M (raised from $117-121M). Source: Q2 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001804176/000180417626000025/bfly-20260730xexx991.htm (2026-07-30). Street revenue consensus disagrees by source: Benzinga $28.8M, Earnings Whispers $29.9M (another EW page $28.09M); EPS -$0.03 to -$0.04 (https://kr.benzinga.com/quote/BFLY/earnings-forecasts, https://www.earningswhispers.com/epsdetails/BFLY). I sized against ~$29M (consensus midpoint), with the company guide top of $30M as the line a 'beat above guide' has to clear. Q2 printed $32.6M against a $27-31M guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 33.59M shares at the 2026-10-15 settlement, 6.19 days to cover, about 12.6% of shares outstanding (more as a share of float, because the founder holds Class B). It was 31.64M at 09-30 and 28.74M at 06-30, so it has been rising since mid-year (https://equibles.com/stocks/bfly/shortinterest). Options: 25d skew -1.92 vol points (calls slightly bid), put/call open interest 0.16, so the option book is heavily call-side, event-implied move 15.14% (sealed baseline). Tape: the stock spiked to $9.93 on 2026-09-22 (Needham initiation, +22% that day) and is now $7.735, 22% off its 52-week high, -13.7% over 20 days, +8.9% over the last 5. This is a fairly crowded short paired with a call-heavy option book.

findings.finding: The Q3 guide of $26-30M looks low against the company's own numbers. Q3 2025 revenue was $21.5M, with software and other services at only ~$6.9M; that was before the Midjourney deal (Nov 2025). Embedded revenue was $10.8M in Q2 2026, and on the Q2 call management said it expects to roughly maintain that cadence. They also said several international deals slipped from Q2 into Q3 and promised 'a much stronger third quarter' internationally. Embedded at ~$10M plus a flat core (~$20-21M) gives ~$30-31M, above the guide top ($30M) and above consensus ($28.8-29.9M). That would also force a mechanical FY raise from $119-123M: H1 was $59.1M, so the guide implies Q4 at $32-36M.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue of $32.6M beat the top of the $27-31M guide, came with a FY raise, and the stock rose +15.1% (2026-07-30). Q3 2025 (revenue above estimates, burn at a record low): +31.9%. Q1 2026, a 25% growth quarter: -2.6%. Beats on this line have mostly been bought.
findings.why_not_priced: Consensus at $28.8M (Benzinga) sits inside the guide, so the street has anchored on the company range rather than on the Embedded run-rate. If the street were modelling Embedded at Q2's level, estimates would be at or above $30.5M, not $28-30M. The stock is 22% below its September high, which is not what a priced beat-and-raise looks like.
findings.independence: Q3 2025 base ($21.5M total, $6.9M software & other) comes from a different document, the Q3 2025 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1804176/000180417625000008/bfly-20251031xexx991.htm). Q2 guide versus actual ($27-31M guided, $32.6M printed) comes from the Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001804176/000180417626000014/bfly-20260430xexx991.htm). The transcript is a secondary transcription.

findings.finding: On 2026-09-01, inside Q3, Butterfly signed a multi-year exclusive licensing agreement with Merge Labs, the OpenAI/Sam Altman-backed ultrasound brain-computer-interface company that raised $252M, for its Poseidon Ultrasound-on-Chip. Butterfly is eligible for upfront, milestone and royalty payments; no dollar terms were disclosed. That is a second large Embedded contract after Midjourney ($74M contract, $15M upfront), and its Q3 recognition and terms will first be quantified on the call.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The Embedded/Midjourney line drove the Feb 2026 print (+50.7%) and the Q2 2026 beat (+15.1%). On the Merge announcement day the reported move was conflicting (-9.5% per one source, +3.7% per another).
findings.why_not_priced: No terms were disclosed, so no estimate can include a number for it. The stock has fallen since the announcement rather than re-rating, so the deal's value is not in the price. Midjourney's upfront was recognised against milestones rather than at once, so the Q3 dollars may be small; the size reflects that.
findings.independence: The deal itself is also reported by a separate outlet (https://www.digitalhealthnews.com/sam-altman-backed-merge-labs-butterfly-network-partner-to-advance-ultrasound-based-brain-computer-interfaces). It shares the Embedded line with finding 1, but rests on a different document and a different contract.

findings.finding: Short interest has risen to 33.6M shares (12.6% of shares outstanding, 6.2 days to cover) at the 2026-10-15 settlement, up from 28.7M at 06-30. Option open interest is overwhelmingly calls (put/call 0.16, skew -1.9). A beat lands on a growing, multi-day-to-cover short.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Prior upside prints ran far: +50.7% (Feb 2026), +31.9% (Oct 2025), +15.1% (Jul 2026). A squeeze component is plausible in those moves, but I cannot separate it.
findings.why_not_priced: Positioning is a mechanism rather than information. The baseline does not carry short interest, and a rising short into a name guiding below its own run-rate is a setup for an asymmetric move if the guide is beaten.
findings.independence: The sealed baseline's option data (put/call OI 0.16, skew -1.92) is a different source and points the same way on the upside-convexity read.

findings.finding: Expectations reset after the coverage-initiation spike. BFLY closed at $9.93 on 2026-09-22 after Needham initiated at Buy/$10 (+22% that day), followed by Evercore ($15 PT, 09-29) and Canaccord (Buy/$10, 10-12). Spot is now $7.735: -22% from the high, -13.7% over 20 days, with the stock below every new target.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print came after a comparable initiation spike, so there is no direct history on this line.
findings.why_not_priced: The hype premium from the initiations has round-tripped, so the print is not landing on a stretched run-up. A name that had priced a beat would be sitting near $10, not at $7.7.
findings.independence: Canaccord initiation is listed on the MarketScreener news list (https://ca.marketscreener.com/quote/stock/BUTTERFLY-NETWORK-INC-119073390/news/). The price levels are in the sealed baseline.

findings.finding: The core business is soft, and any beat may be all licensing. In Q2 2026, product revenue fell 5% y/y ($15.7M vs $16.6M) and international fell 14% to $5.0M. Implied core (total less $10.8M Embedded) was ~$21.8M, about +2% y/y, against +10% core growth in Q1. A Q3 that beats only on Embedded while probe sales stay flat is a lower-quality beat.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Aug 2025 (-18.1%) is the last print where core/product softness led, and it was punished. In Q2 2026, product softness was looked through (+15.1%) because Embedded and the guide raise dominated.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline growth of +39% hides the flat core. Previews quote total revenue and the guide, not a core/Embedded split. Shrunk from the draft because short interest is 12.6% (a crowded short argues against sizing a negative large).
findings.independence: The Q1 2026 core/Embedded split ($20.8M core +10%, $5.7M Embedded) comes from the Q1 release (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001804176/000180417626000014/bfly-20260430xexx991.htm). This finding shares the Q2 release with finding 1 and sizes the opposite risk: finding 1 assumes core is flat, and this one says flat core is what the reaction may punish.

findings.finding: Insiders have kept selling into the period. Founder Jonathan Rothberg sold ~$21M in July 2026, and a stream of Form 144s and Form 4s followed from August to October 2026 (GC 09-02 $13.9k, CAO 09-04 $100.8k, further 144s on 09-22/09-23, 10-02 and 10-06). There were no insider buys.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: There is no measurable history of this line moving the stock; the July founder sale preceded a +15% print.
findings.why_not_priced: The sales are mostly 10b5-1 and tax-withholding, are public, and are small apart from the founder. They are close to fully priced and are filed small for completeness.
findings.independence: EDGAR submissions list the Form 144 and Form 4 cadence (https://data.sec.gov/submissions/CIK0001804176.json).

findings.finding: Post-quarter commercial news gives the call forward material for Q4 and 2027 commentary: VCOM long-term alliance (10-13: iQ3 for every first-year student starting with the 2026 class, plus discounted iQ+), Bridge Neurotech BCI partnership (10-06), Mendaera Focalist compatibility (10-01), and Home & Community Care live in its first state from 10-01 (revenue in Q4, in guidance).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Guide raises have been bought (Jul 2026 +15.1%, Feb 2026 +50.7%).
findings.why_not_priced: None of these deals carries disclosed dollars, so they cannot sit in estimates. Home Care is already inside the FY guide, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: The VCOM release is separately covered by AuntMinnie (https://www.auntminnie.com/clinical-news/ultrasound/news/15837314/butterfly-network-vcom-form-handheld-ultrasound-education-alliance). The Home Care timing comes from the Q2 call transcript (https://www.webull.com/news/15341695022539776).

outside_window.finding: Apollo chip delivery to Midjourney is scheduled for end-2027/early-2028; that commercialisation (chip sales and revenue share) is the long-dated Embedded catalyst.

rejected_candidates.candidate: FedRAMP full certification slipped past its Q3 target (negative)
rejected_candidates.detail: Only the promise (Q3) is sourced. Nothing shows it was missed; the absence of a press release is not a dated fact.

rejected_candidates.candidate: Board changes: Erica Schwartz resigned on CDC confirmation (08-05); Mike Noonen appointed (10-09)
rejected_candidates.detail: The 8-K states no disagreement and nothing that bears on Q3 numbers. I judged it immaterial rather than contradicted, but filed it here so the panel sees it.

baseline_tension: The findings lean up. That agrees with the mildly call-bid skew (-1.92) and the call-heavy open interest, and cuts against the -13.7% 20-day run-up, which reads as the September initiation hype unwinding rather than as priced disappointment.
lessons_applied: Lesson 9 (size a segment finding net of the rest) plus the Midjourney milestone-based recognition: cut Merge Labs from +1.5 to +1.0, because an upfront may be recognised over time and the finding shares the Embedded line with finding 1.
Lesson 7 (look up short interest before a negative): short is 12.6% of shares out with 6.2 days to cover, so the core-softness negative went from -1.5 to -1.0.
Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the bar is sourced to the company guide; estimate sources disagree ($28.8M vs $29.9M), so finding 1 is sized against the guide top as well as consensus, and stays at +2.5.

Lesson 1 (a verified fact is not a predicted reaction): checked reaction history on the revenue/Embedded line; beats have mostly been bought (+15.1%, +31.9%, +50.7%), so no veto. p_up is held at 58 because the fact is inferred, not disclosed.
Net: the post-lessons sum equals the draft sum (3.7) by offset, not because nothing changed.
